propositions: The bridge is hardwired to a single project at three points (JiraConfig.project scalar, fetcher JQL pair, applier cross-project guard) and cannot serve teams running multiple tracker projects against one codebase.

A tri-state ticket project field (absent=legacy, empty=never sync, key=sync there) with store-owned project mapping enables many-to-many between N repos and N projects via a shared ticket store without per-repo conflict.

Multi-project inbound fetch must iterate the configured project set for base JQL and three enrichment passes (parent/comment/issuelink), merging results into one snapshot keyed by issue, with per-query truncation scoped per project.

A store whose mapping holds more than one project must carry 'multi-project-bridge' in .store-compat.json required_capabilities, and a binary lacking it must refuse writes while single-project stores remain writable.
Absent project fields resolve to the recorded legacy default via idempotent ensure unit with zero event writes, avoiding four-figure event overhead under store lock.
Outbound updates and creates must respect per-ticket project, enforcing set membership rather than single-project equality, while empty project produces no mutations.
